scope: 33 named catalog operations; equal-weight executable build coverage of frozen source, not elapsed effort, feature-weighted progress or live readiness.

definition.BUILT: Concrete executable implementation exists for the named operation contract; provider/capture/input credentials and deferred proof alone are not missing code.
definition.PARTIAL: Concrete implementation exists, but identified requested controls or native identity/action paths within the recorded operation area remain unimplemented or cannot complete on the measured native shape.
definition.GENERIC_ONLY: Named operation has only generic recorded-profile execution, without a dedicated implementation.
